an5.73:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.73:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu dhammavihārī hotī ti? 2.
an5.73:2.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an5.73:2.3: So tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānam, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.73:2.4: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī. 3.
an5.73:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti.
an5.73:3.2: So tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.73:3.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī. 4.
an5.73:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti.
an5.73:4.2: So tena sajjhāyena divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.73:4.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu sajjhāyabahulo, no dhammavihārī. 5.
an5.73:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
an5.73:5.2: So tehi dhammavitakkehi divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.73:5.3: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu vitakkabahulo, no dhammavihārī. 6.
an5.73:6.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an5.73:6.3: So tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti, na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.73:6.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti. 7.
an5.73:7.1: Iti kho bhikkhu bhikkhu desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.
an5.73:7.2: Yaṃ bhikkhu Satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
an5.73:7.3: Etāni bhikkhu rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha bhikkhu mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī
